 Summary Statement
 Obligation to provide a confidential report has been met and all initial reporting and compliance measures have been taken to comply with the Conflict of Interest Act .
 Recusal
 On May 12, 2021, in the exercise of my official duties, I recused myself from participating in the nomination process of a Board Member for the Canadian Race Relations Foundation, in order to avoid any opportunity to further the private interest of a friend.
 Compliance Order under Section 30
 WHEREAS you are appointed Director of Labour Relations in the Office of the President of the Treasury Board; 
WHEREAS pursuant to subsection 28 of the Conflict of Interest Act, I am required to review annually with you, as a reporting public office holder, the information contained in your confidential report and the measures taken to satisfy your obligations under the Act; 
WHEREAS an email dated May 24, 2022, was sent to you asking that you return all necessary documents to complete your Annual Review to the Office within 30 days; 
WHEREAS despite many reminders, your Annual Review remains outstanding on the day of this Order; 
AND WHEREAS pursuant to section 19 of the Conflict of Interest Act, compliance with the Act is a condition of a person's appointment or employment as a public office holder; 
I THEREFORE ORDER YOU to submit to my Office, within 10 days of the deemed date of service of this order, all documents identified in the letter dated May 24, 2022, all of which are required to complete your Annual Review.
